Definition: neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe:--Illyricum.
BiblicalUsage: Illyricum was the far edge of Paul's preaching, the region along the Adriatic coast. In Romans 15:19 Paul says he has fully preached the gospel of Christ from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one verse maps the whole mission: from Jerusalem to Illyricum, Paul carried the gospel until there was no more road to run.
